source.displayValues: uint8 windowed source; no HU calibration

sampling: Exact current world plane converted to source coordinates; trilinear uint8 scalar; nearest-neighbor categorical label; same endpoint registration as viewer.
limitations: Regional labels are approximate tissue ownership, not expert reference, blood pools, valves, individual vessels or appendages.
Compact shared septal core is colored LV by convention; raw LV/RV tissue fractions cannot decide correctness on their own.
Areas and track proximity are screening evidence for manual source inspection, not clinical accuracy or chamber-volume measurements.
The displayed source bank is windowed uint8 at 317.6 micrometers; not calibrated Hounsfield units.

me5c.name: Midesophageal five-chamber
me5c.summary: Both ventricular/AV-junction regions are retained with a stronger LV outflow and aortic-root section; some apical foreshortening is accepted.
remainingLimits: Some apical foreshortening is accepted for the five-chamber target.

me4c.name: Midesophageal four-chamber
me4c.summary: The plane now follows both AV-junction regions and the LV apex while removing the previously dominant aortic-outflow profile.
remainingLimits: AV-junction and septal identities are approximate source landmarks, not an expert reference registration.

mecommissural.name: Midesophageal mitral commissural
mecommissural.summary: A broader mitral-region and long-LV section replaces the outflow-containing starting plane; scallop correspondence remains unresolved.
remainingLimits: Individual P3/A2/P1 scallops and paired papillary identities are not independently annotated.

me2c.name: Midesophageal two-chamber
me2c.summary: Long LA–mitral-region–LV continuity is retained with little right-heart tissue; visually cleaner than lower-cost candidates that resembled four-chamber sections.
remainingLimits: Anterior/inferior wall identity is not independently registered to a living-patient TEE acquisition.

melax.name: Midesophageal long-axis
melax.summary: A continuous source section connects the LV/mitral region with the LV outflow and elongated aortic root; display orientation places outflow to the right.
remainingLimits: The collapsed LV and adjoining fibrous/valvar tissue do not reproduce a normal clinical echo cavity.

meavlax.name: Midesophageal aortic valve long-axis
meavlax.summary: Root/cusp and proximal ascending-aortic continuity were selected together with the LA near-field region; the root axis is displayed horizontally.
remainingLimits: Valve annulus, sinotubular junction and cusp identities are not separate measured segmentations.

meaaolax.name: Midesophageal ascending aorta long-axis
meaaolax.summary: A long section follows the retained ascending-aortic lumen and walls; the LA region constrains the plane azimuth.
remainingLimits: The ascending vessel ends are specimen-truncated; no aortic arch is present.

meaaosax.name: Midesophageal ascending aorta short-axis
meaaosax.summary: The selected section is perpendicular to the retained ascending-aortic segment, separate from the valve-level short-axis target.
remainingLimits: SVC and right pulmonary-artery identities are not independently established.
The nearby SVC and right pulmonary artery have not been individually verified.

merpv.name: Midesophageal right pulmonary vein
merpv.summary: The closest available LA/venous-entry region was reviewed in multiple planes; the two right pulmonary-vein ostia are not individually confirmed.
remainingLimits: Individual pulmonary-vein ostia and LAA are not separately annotated; no complete named-target correspondence is asserted.

meavsax.name: Midesophageal aortic valve short-axis
meavsax.summary: The plane is moved from ventricular/outflow tissue to the source-observed three-sinus/cusp region of the aortic root.
remainingLimits: The root/cusp level is source-reviewed; individual cusp labels and exact annular dimensions are unvalidated.

mervinout.name: Midesophageal RV inflow-outflow
mervinout.summary: An anatomy-fitted section connects the tricuspid-side RV with the muscular outflow/pulmonary-valve region; inflow is displayed to the left.
remainingLimits: Regional inflow/outflow continuity is visually reviewed; individual valve leaflets/cusps are not segmented or verified.

memodbicaval.name: Midesophageal modified bicaval tricuspid valve
memodbicaval.summary: The section is centered on RA–tricuspid-region–RV continuity, while individual caval and leaflet identities remain uncertain.
remainingLimits: Caval ostia and leaflet identities remain unresolved.

bicaval.name: Midesophageal bicaval
bicaval.summary: Atrial and septal-side continuity is favored over ventricular/outflow tissue; the preserved specimen does not establish both caval ostia.
remainingLimits: Both caval ostia and continuous IAS cannot be confidently identified in the truncated specimen.

mepv.name: Midesophageal right and left pulmonary veins
mepv.summary: A source-reviewed LA/venous-entry plane is shown; right and left pulmonary-vein acquisitions are distinct clinical maneuvers, and all four ostia are not established here.
remainingLimits: Individual pulmonary-vein ostia and LAA are not separately annotated; no complete named-target correspondence is asserted.

melaa.name: Midesophageal left atrial appendage
melaa.summary: Multiple lateral-LA sections were examined. The original lateral atrial region is retained because no candidate established a more defensible LAA ostial/lobe section.
remainingLimits: Individual pulmonary-vein ostia and LAA are not separately annotated; no complete named-target correspondence is asserted.

tgbasalsax.name: Transgastric basal short-axis
tgbasalsax.summary: An independently oriented basal LA–LV interface section shows a broader mitral-region opening and removes the dominant arterial-root star of the earlier plane.
remainingLimits: Papillary/leaflet profiles are assessed on measured pixels; the fixed LV cavity is collapsed.
This is a mitral-region correspondence; exact leaflet/annular boundaries and the clinical fishmouth appearance remain unvalidated.

tgpapillary.name: Transgastric midpapillary short-axis
tgpapillary.summary: The original plane is retained after broad exploration and 21 close neighbors: its two principal muscular profiles are clearer than the newly proposed level.
remainingLimits: Papillary/leaflet profiles are assessed on measured pixels; the fixed LV cavity is collapsed.

tgapicalsax.name: Transgastric apical short-axis
tgapicalsax.summary: The original distal ventricular plane is retained after broad exploration and 21 close neighbors; it avoids the dominant papillary profile seen in more proximal candidates.
remainingLimits: Papillary/leaflet profiles are assessed on measured pixels; the fixed LV cavity is collapsed.

tgrvbasal.name: Transgastric RV basal
tgrvbasal.summary: A plane based on the reviewed tricuspid hinge neighborhood replaces the duplicated LV/root-level cut; exact en-face tricuspid correspondence remains partial.
remainingLimits: The curved tricuspid hinge departs from a flat plane; this is not an annular measurement.
A flat cut cannot reproduce the curved TV hinge perfectly; a complete en-face three-leaflet view is not established.

tgrvinout.name: Transgastric RV inflow-outflow
tgrvinout.summary: The selected measured plane follows RV inflow and outflow regions around the aortic root, replacing a nonspecific transverse cut.
remainingLimits: Regional inflow/outflow continuity is visually reviewed; individual valve leaflets/cusps are not segmented or verified.

deeptg5c.name: Deep transgastric five-chamber
deeptg5c.summary: The section brings both ventricular regions and LV outflow into one measured plane with a gastric-side presentation.
remainingLimits: Gastric approach orientation is illustrative; esophagus and stomach are absent from the scan.

tg2c.name: Transgastric two-chamber
tg2c.summary: The new measured plane excludes the long aortic pathway seen previously and isolates the LA–mitral-region–LV sequence; the apex is displayed to the left.
remainingLimits: Gastric approach orientation is illustrative; esophagus and stomach are absent from the scan.

tgrvin.name: Transgastric RV inflow
tgrvin.summary: An independent TV–RV-body–apical-RV plane replaces the generic tilted starting frame, with RV/apical tissue to the left and the tricuspid/atrial side to the right.
remainingLimits: Tricuspid leaflet and subvalvular identities are not individually segmented.

tglax.name: Transgastric long-axis
tglax.summary: The section follows the long LV into its outflow/root, with the ventricular/apical side to the left and basal outflow to the right.
remainingLimits: Gastric approach orientation is illustrative; esophagus and stomach are absent from the scan.

daolax.disposition: No acquired CT target; must remain explicitly outside scan.

uearchlax.disposition: No acquired CT target; must remain explicitly outside scan.

uearchsax.disposition: No acquired CT target; must remain explicitly outside scan.
